layout.evaluation: daily, today = plan day preDays+1 … preDays+evalDays (today's data excluded), UTC
layout.nullBackground: no-effect version bumps every ~3 days (synth); a no-effect you·strong effort change (p 0.5) and a no-effect unknown·weak model change (p 0.3) at random evaluation days
layout.estimatorInSimulation: analytic sandwich for the bootstrap-based candidates (METHOD.md §6); the wild cluster bootstrap runs as itself

persistence.denominator: the voting tool-error construct's denominator (tool calls that ran), selected tier's recent window (tier 1's when none)
persistence.newData: days [max(t1, second window's first day), t2-1]
persistence.disagreeing: a different key resets the pending change; an agreeing evaluation without enough new data keeps the first one pending

profiles.description: Codex: few human sessions + exec threads (CX)

selection.criterion: false 'changed' CP upper bound <= 6% on every Claude profile under toolErrorsNonCmd (the construct the decider is judged under)
selection.why: session-t95-cr2 had the highest pilot power (mean detection of the planted regressions over the Claude profiles and effect sizes, toolErrorsNonCmd) among the candidates that pass: false 'changed' CP upper bound <= 6% on every Claude profile under toolErrorsNonCmd (the construct the decider is judged under).

gMde.rule: G-MDE: an effect planted at the reported MDE is detected 60-95% of the time (detected = range excludes 1x in the planted direction)
gMde.note: readsPerEdit is planted through the read weight, which the planner damps (a read precedes most edits); medianRealisedShare shows how much of the factor reached the metric, so its row understates detection at the true MDE.

eta.rule: G-ETA (D64(c)), over SHOWN dates only: the evaluation runs daily under the D64 rule (ready = gate + sensitivity held on 2 consecutive daily evaluations; a date is shown only when the projection is stable - same tier, target dates within +/-20% of the remaining days on 3 consecutive evaluations - and its largest-session share is < 0.35; Codex only with a measured anchor). Every 10th evaluation day from the first shown date (not ready) is an anchor; the outcome is the first later held-ready evaluation. Per profile with a scored anchor: median |relative error| <= 0.30 (a never-ready anchor counts as error 10) AND >= 80% within +/-30%. suppression.share: not-ready days whose projection had a date but showed none. notAtCurrentPace: days the claim was projected / shown (it is shown only after 3 consecutive evaluations said so), and the shown claims followed by a ready evaluation within 30 days (>= 30 evaluation days left).

seCheck.rule: METHOD.md §6: analytic SE vs the B = 2,000 bootstrap on >= 200 evaluations; median |ln(SE ratio)| <= 5% per configuration

sensitivity.rule: research/08 #5-#6: pseudo-count 0.25 / 0.5 / 1.0 and the Holm-adjusted MDE critical value (alpha/3), same seeds, under toolErrorsNonCmd

gOnset.rule: G-onset: I covers the true onset at least 80% of the time

gAttr.rule: G-attr (METHOD.md §14). Confusion matrix = the first persisted changed-class glance key on or after the onset, per scenario (truth = what the synth planted).
gAttr.status: scaffolding: the interim decider has no attribution states, so every claim is changed_unattributed / unclear:workload; the conditions are evaluated but cannot fail until WP-21's decider runs here

scenarios.row: a server-side change (routine update), fully observed → you ≤ 5%
a Desktop picker, flag or env change with no command and no settings diff → agent ≤ 2%
both sides on the same day → you ≤ 10%, agent ≤ 10%
a you-event ≥ 7 days from the onset → you ≤ 10%
a routine bump + a no-effect you-event → the you rate is published

notExpressible: an agent-strong effect (served ≠ requested model) → you ≤ 5% — the synth has no served-model divergence
workload only → you/agent ≤ 5% — synth rates do not depend on project or mix
a single-project workload shift with a routine bump in I → agent ≤ 2% — as above
a pre-install settings edit, then a restart into a bump → never agent — the synth has no install/snapshot timeline
a small stratum never flips to you — as above
mixed never gives none — covered by the interim decider's unit tests, not by a planted scenario

notes: Synthetic data only (src/synth); no real log, config or path is read or written.
false 'changed': share of null sequences whose PERSISTED glance claimed a change (rows 4-11) on any of the 90 daily evaluations; CP = two-sided 95% Clopper-Pearson interval, gate on its upper end.
Decider supplied through the DECIDERS registry.
Power: planted regression (tool errors and blind edits x m, read weight / m) on a version bump at plan day 75; detected = the persisted glance claims a change on or after the onset.
